title: Health Reminder
lead: Track sedentary monitoring, today's presence rhythm, and reminder settings in one focused panel.
activityLead: Review today's present time by app, window title, and hour.
noActiveWindow: No active work window right now
chartsLead: Review today's present time by app, window title, and hour.
workWindowDescription: Trigger a sedentary reminder after this much continuous work.
breakDescription: Treat the current work session as rested after this much inactivity.
notifyDescription: Send a native system notification when a sedentary reminder fires.
recordWindowTitleDescription: Include foreground window titles in activity details for better stats.
retainDaysDescription: Activity details older than this will be cleaned up.
settingsLead: These settings are written back as the complete local health reminder config.
templatesLead: Each reminder can choose its own trigger, completion, and charging credit. Water, rest, and kegel are built in and can only be turned off.
creditMinutesDescription: Minutes added to the charging balance when this reminder is completed. 0 means no credit.
dailyCapDescription: How many completed sessions can credit today. Further completions add nothing.
intervalDescription: Fire again this many minutes after the last complete, skip, or snooze.
thresholdDescription: Fire after this much continuous work in the shared window. Multiple sedentary templates share one clock.
sessionDescription: The backend owns the end time and records completion when it reaches zero.
enabledDescription: When disabled, activity sampling stops and health reminders will not fire.
topWindowsCaption: Sorted by today's active minutes. Requires “Record window title”.
hourlyCaption: See when your present time is concentrated.
reminderTitle: Time to stand up and move 🌿
reminderBody: You've been working for a while. Stand up and stretch a bit.
waterBody: Remember to stay hydrated. Have a sip of water.
staleRefreshFailed: Health data refresh failed; showing last known data
loadFailed: Failed to load health status. Please retry.
